title: W2 POS PPOB paid-cash capture and accounting settlement
businessRules: All PPOB purchases require connected integration, explicit opt-in, cashier OPEN shift and verified no-tax product classification; no paid request may be enqueued before POSTED Accounting Core advance receipt in one serializable transaction.
No unverified tax assumption, missing provider asset account, missing posting rules, unknown provider cost or unlimited provider maxPrice may accept customer money.

Fulfillment requires explicit provider SUCCESS, POSTED prepayment, configured tenant-owned ASSET provider balance and bounded final cost; settlement is idempotent and journal-posted through Accounting Core.

Refund requires explicit provider FAILED, prior paid receipt, no settlement, open authorized cash drawer with enough cash, and new Accounting Core refund posting. PENDING/unknown is never automatically refundable.
Idempotent replay must preserve tenant, branch, actor, SKU, customer destination, paymentMethod and maxPrice. Worker must reject unpaid legacy events before making external provider calls.
Digiflazz catalog cannot forge tax approval; verified classification preserved only when product identity does not change.
All source gates remain, P5 visual and Human Stage-20 PENDING, no GitHub push or production readiness is asserted.

Perlakuan pajak NO_TAX_VERIFIED wajib didukung penetapan Finance sesuai aturan pajak berversi dan periode berlaku; transaksi kena pajak ditahan sampai Tax Core dapat menghitung kode/versi efektif yang sah.
acceptanceCriteria: Cash capture, accounting advance and outbox creation are atomic and survive identical retry without double cash or provider event.
Preflight denies missing active rules, provider balance account, unverified tax, missing cost/maxPrice, disabled integration and absent shift without cash mutation.
Settlement and cash refund create balanced, immutable, idempotent journals; no refund on ambiguous provider state.
Shift reports count captured PPOB cash and refunded cash in proper cashier shifts.
Operator POS and Admin expose cash-only purchase, provider status/recheck, tax verification, explicit settlement/refund, and a default-off activation control.
SQLite+PostgreSQL schema parity and additive migration rehearsal PASS; mandatory local full gates and exact-commit GitHub UAT remain to run.
testPlan: npm run workflow:validate && npm run validate:repo && npm run audit:full:repo
npm run uat:pre-github:local on complete Ubuntu source, official SQLite profile and full dependencies.

On disposable TEST PostgreSQL, rehearse expand migration, duplicate capture/refund, posted journal balancing, cross-branch/operator denial, period closing, POS browser and live worker with stub Digiflazz test endpoint.
Exact source/commit GitHub Full System Simulation and Full Automated UAT; Human Stage-20 separate and not auto-accepted.

Replay/idempotency and offline conflict proof: retry identical paid PPOB key cannot duplicate posted journal or provider outbox; altered payload or foreign branch fails closed, and no offline PPOB payment is permitted.
migrationPlan: Expand-only nullable fields and indexes in SQLite+PostgreSQL DigitalServiceTransaction. Historical rows remain unpaid and cannot dispatch from worker; no backfill of invented payment evidence. Requires Finance to create/verify ASSET provider balance code and three active posting rules before enabling integration. Rehearse migration against disposable clones.
rollbackPlan: Disable integration.config.ppobCashEnabled first to stop new captures; retain all posted AccountingEvent, refunds and historical paid rows. Revert code only with an explicit reconciliation and provider outbox quarantine plan; never delete journals or columns containing business evidence.
monitoringPlan: Track unpaid outbox rejected, stale PENDING requests, missing active posting rules, unmatched SUCCESS/FAILED, unposted settlement/refund, provider cost exceeding maxPrice and shift cash variances by branch. Redact customerNo/secrets.
securityNotes: No arbitrary companyId/branchId in public DTO; tenant context trusted. Default feature flag OFF; strong receipt-bound dispatch; no provider credentials in archive or audit.
